Interface PoolChat

All Known Implementing Classes:
PoolChatServer
public interface PoolChat
The PoolChat interface is the server-side contract for one pool seat per SSH user. A blank host keeps the local grok agent stdio child. A set host dials grok agent serve. The contract has no SSH types and no Swing types. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#PoolChat

    • start

      void start(String user) throws Exception
      The method brings that user's child to a ready process.
      Parameters:
      user - The user is the SSH user name.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the process did not start.

    • prompt

      void prompt(String user, String text, String boot, boolean think, String rules, PoolChat.Sink sink) throws Exception
      The method runs one prompt and blocks until PoolChat.Sink.done(String, String) has run, or until the fit check stops the prompt. A non-empty boot may reuse the session and send only the tail. The text is the whole working set of plain role lines.
      Parameters:
      user - The user is the SSH user name.
      text - The text is the whole working set of plain role lines.
      boot - The boot is the desktop boot id. An empty string means the client sent none.
      think - The flag is true when thought chunks are of interest.
      rules - The rules are the extra rule text for the next session. An empty string means the mood pair is off.
      sink - The sink receives the frames.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception on interrupt, or for a failure the sink did not already take.

    • cancel

      void cancel(String user)
      The method cancels the in-flight prompt for that user. The child stays up. A second call is safe.
      Parameters:
      user - The user is the SSH user name.

    • health

      PoolChat.Health health(String user)
      The method reports whether that user's child can take a prompt. The result is ready, down, or auth. The result contains no secret.
      Parameters:
      user - The user is the SSH user name.
      Returns:
      The return value is PoolChat.Health.READY, PoolChat.Health.DOWN, or PoolChat.Health.AUTH.

    • shutdown

      void shutdown()
      The method destroys every child process.
